title: Fair questions.
q1: Is the free plan really free?
a1: Yes. Every finished feature is free and stays that way. Modules still in beta, AutoMod and Discord right now, open to Premium channels first. I built it because good tools shouldn't depend on your budget.
q2: So what am I actually paying for with Premium?
a2: Priority and early access. Premium messages jump to the front of the line, so commands land faster when chat is busiest, and Premium channels get beta modules first. It keeps the servers running, too.
a3: One click from the dashboard. You keep the perks until the end of the billing period you already paid for.
a4: Dedicated hardware, multi-streamer management, custom terms, and direct engineering support. Write to enterprise@itsbagelbot.com for a quote.
a5: ItsBagelBot's source is on GitHub under a source-available licence, which is not the same as open source. You can read and audit every line, but the licence limits redistribution and commercial use.
